description: The plot in Figure 8 illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers for various configurations of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct with SnapKV as the pruning method and a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis represents the layer groups, labeled as Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, with no numeric scale or units provided. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, marked at intervals of 5%. The plot contains five lines: a black dashed line representing the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit; a blue line with circle markers for LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit, starting at approximately 0% and decreasing to around -12% before increasing back to 0%; a blue dashed line for RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit, showing a similar trend; a red line with square markers for LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit, also decreasing to around -12% before returning to 0%; and a red dashed line for RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit, following a comparable pattern. All solid lines exhibit a decline from Layer1-4 to Layer13-20, with values dropping to around -12%, before rising back to approximately 0% at Layer29-32.
